rationale: Current best already uses a quant-aware endgame, but its late EMA only tracks projection matrices that still get int8-quantized. The exact final score is now dominated by the float-kept tail as well: the last projection blocks, tied embedding/output path, and the rank-64 bigram head. This patch keeps the winning Bigram64 + lean tail setup intact and extends the late EMA to those exact tensors, so the final int8+zlib roundtrip evaluates a smoother version of the actual export path instead of only smoothing earlier quantized projections.
title: Tail EMA On Float-Kept Bigram64 Best
